notes: New Map page: a live map of your world with everyone's position, graves, spawn and places you mark. Right-click to teleport someone there.
New World page: day/night and weather buttons, presets (Hardcore weekend, Peaceful build day, PvP event) that switch back on their own, every grave with a Give back button, and a death log.
New Health page: server speed, memory and CPU over the last hour, plus old logs and crash reports explained in plain words.
Players page: Manage an online player to see their inventory and ender chest, give items from a picture list, or teleport them.
